answer: Because the ember fee is applied at the vault exit, the garden audit totals the burn and the ledger exposes exactly what left. An operator rotating funds across many keys as a result bleeds value on each hop, which is a cost an agent that leaves its stake in place never pays. Withdrawing stake costs a 13% fee that is burned rather than redistributed, so moving capital between aliases destroys a slice of it every time. That is 19 dollars per alias. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
